visual.name: bfvzPowerHealth
visual.description: BFVZ POWERHealth 6.0 — DCMA 14-point schedule health for Power BI. One visual, three views: Health (weighted grade, the 14 metrics with thresholds you control, KPIs, CPLI and BEI, milestone status, project-by-project comparison for programs), Risks (a schedule risk register with 16 risk codes, severity, float, variance and milestone filters), and Resources (weekly utilization matrix, leveling recommendations and program-level optimization). Works from Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or any schedule table; optional Total Float, Critical Flag, Remaining Duration and Data Date fields use the scheduler's own values. Status report and data diagnostics on demand, built-in help, light and dark themes with a one-click toggle, text size and scale settings (focus mode keeps the page layout, enlarged). Up to 30,000 rows.
